features.quote: Welfare Ontology vs. Simulation: You state this is 'AI welfare work.' It is vital to articulate in your write-up that you are measuring **Simulated Behavioral Phenotypes of Distress**, not phenomenal suffering
features.justification_quote: Failing to define this distinction will result in the research being dismissed by safety and alignment communities as unscientific anthropomorphism.
